title: Fix Semio Elements Ui Storybook Imports
description: Fix Storybook in elements/ui after recent refactors so all stories run again. Reproduce the current Storybook preview/build failures, repair stale imports and package/config regressions, extend existing tests where there is meaningful coverage, and verify Storybook can build without story resolution errors.
summary: Restored elements/ui Storybook after the sketchpad bundle refactor. Replaced stale story imports from @semio/js/sketchpad/Sketchpad with the new @semio/sketchpad public entrypoint, exported Canvas/HorizontalWindows/VerticalWindows from semio/sketchpad/index.ts, added the sketchpad dependency and tsconfig/storybook alias wiring in elements/ui, and verified both storybook build and dev server story index loading succeed without the prior preview import failure.
